project.title: Teigetje & Woelrat
project.description: A bilingual collection website for an Amsterdam fashion and design label, from Figma design to a React build.
project.introText: A collection website for Teigetje & Woelrat, an Amsterdam label working across fashion, design and interior art. I designed it in Figma and built it as a React site.

gridImages.caption: Collection pieces, each with its name, category and price.
Archived Pieces: garments from past collections, with their own filters.
History page: how the label began.

project.middleText: The site has a collection page of ready-to-wear pieces with filters, an archive of pieces from past collections, a history of the label told as a timeline from 1972 onwards, an about page and a contact page, all in English and Dutch.
project.conclusionText: Built with React, TypeScript and Vite from the Figma design.
project.highlightCaption: Collection page: ready-to-wear pieces, filtered by category and material and sorted by price.

summary.brief: A collection website for an Amsterdam label working across fashion, design and interior art.
summary.role: Design in Figma and front-end development.
summary.method: Collection and archive pages with filters, the label's history as a timeline, English and Dutch throughout.
summary.outcome: A bilingual site for the label's collection and archive.

facts: on every page, filter and label
the current collection and the archive, browsed apart
to today: the label’s history as a timeline
project.shows: A client commission taken from Figma to a working bilingual site, built around how visitors browse a label’s collection and its history.

decisions.choice: Keep the current collection and the archive of past pieces apart, each with its own filters.
decisions.why: The label’s work runs from 1972 to today; current pieces should not be buried among fifty years of past ones.
decisions.result: Visitors browse what is available now, or explore the label’s history, without one getting in the way of the other.

decisions.choice: One language switch for the whole site, rather than separate Dutch and English pages.
decisions.why: Every page, filter and label exists in both languages, so switching should keep the visitor where they are.

decisions.choice: Compress every image to at most 1920 pixels wide, at near-lossless quality, before publishing.
decisions.why: It is an image-led site served from a standard host.
decisions.result: The photographs keep their quality at a fraction of the file size.
